title: 'It doesn’t have to be so that boards of directors must sell the company to a bidder paying 10 cents more per share'
summary: Tiago has written 279 Goodreads reviews. He reads the book as a case that a company can seek money without deciding everything on the short term, and closes on Ries's own warning that it is too early to change a structure until it is too late.
blockquote: For example, it doesn’t have to be so that boards of directors must sell the company to a bidder paying 10 cents more per share if that buyer goes against the company’s reason of being.
